artifacts.description: Immutable Delivery request bound to a verified Development candidate and either a real release policy plus operator authorization or an explicit deferred profile.
Complete deterministic release-guard evidence for the exact certified candidate.
Authorized decision bound to the candidate, preflight snapshot and release policy.
Durable desired-state action receipts, including uncertain external responses. Produced by a deterministic kernel handler that calls the publication provider.
Authoritative post-action state observations used to settle external effects safely. Produced by a deterministic kernel handler that calls the observation provider.
Canonical record of every observed release destination for the certified candidate.
Immutable Delivery settlement decision and exact product-lineage hashes.

nodes.description: Evaluate deterministic release guards for the exact certified candidate and immutable release policy.
nodes.label: Preflight Release

nodes.description: Materialize an authorized decision bound to the exact candidate, preflight result and release policy.
nodes.label: Approve Release

nodes.description: Apply immutable desired-state actions through explicit providers using deterministic cross-run action keys. Deterministic external-system calls (git push, deploy), not worker hiring.
nodes.label: Publish and Deploy

nodes.description: Read authoritative target state after every publish/deploy response, including uncertain and failed responses. Deterministic external-system observation, not worker hiring.
nodes.label: Observe Release

nodes.description: Validate exact durable products and candidate immutability, then issue a canonical release record and certificate.
nodes.label: Settle Delivery

nodes.description: Emit the local Delivery process outcome 'released'.
nodes.label: Complete: released

nodes.description: Emit the local Delivery process outcome 'approval-required'.
nodes.label: Complete: approval-required

nodes.description: Emit the local Delivery process outcome 'blocked'.
nodes.label: Complete: blocked

nodes.description: Emit the local Delivery process outcome 'failed'.
nodes.label: Complete: failed

identity.description: Approves, publishes, deploys and authoritatively observes one immutable verified candidate.
identity.name: delivery-release

invariants.description: No externally-visible release action may begin without an explicit operator grant bound to the immutable release policy and either the exact candidate or the candidate produced by the same Lifecycle.
Human approval binds the candidate hash, preflight hash and release-policy hash and cannot float to a later revision.
Every guard, decision, publication and observation provider is injected explicitly; no fallback may perform release effects.
Retries use the deterministic action key and authoritative target observation before any external action is repeated.
A successful command response alone never establishes release; settlement requires matching authoritative observed state.
Release adapters must not force push, bypass branch protection, bypass registry immutability or bypass deployment policy.
Any candidate hash change after Development certification blocks Delivery and requires fresh Development verification.
Delivery emits a local outcome and does not decide lifecycle routing.

outcomes.description: Every required release action is authoritatively observed at its desired state.
A current authorized human decision is required before release effects may begin.
A policy guard, denied decision, unavailable provider or inconclusive external state blocks release.
Delivery integrity, lineage or external-state validation failed.

policies.description: Requires complete trusted checks for the exact certified candidate before human approval.
Admits a release only when authorized desired-state actions are authoritatively observed.
